description: On explicit user request: one request from a registered user is enough, MFM processes it (no minimum number of requests; up to 5 requests per account per calendar month, UTC, on the site and through AI together, PDF and full combined; a repeat costs nothing). analysis=full queues full calculations for a level 3 company overnight, permanently, globally deduplicated by company. The default analysis=pdf queues PDF/interim reading within 7 days.

analysis.description: full: persistent level 3 full calculations overnight; pdf (default): PDF/interim reading within 7 days. Both count in the 5 requests per account per month

company_id.description: MFM company id (from search or fetch) of the company for which the user explicitly asked an analysis on request.

user_requested_submission.description: Must be true, and only when the user explicitly asked to send this request.

name: request_update
title: Request a company update
